description: Flyway Migration Management - Introduce Flyway to manage the portfolio database schema through versioned SQL migration files, replacing Hibernate ddl-auto=update with ddl-auto=validate.

userStories.title: Add Flyway dependency and configuration
userStories.description: As a developer, I want Flyway integrated into the Spring Boot app so that schema migrations run automatically on startup.
acceptanceCriteria: flyway-core added to pom.xml (Spring Boot manages version via BOM)
flyway-database-postgresql added to pom.xml (required for Flyway 10+)
application.properties updated: spring.jpa.hibernate.ddl-auto=validate
application.properties updated: spring.flyway.baseline-on-migrate=true
application.properties updated: spring.flyway.baseline-version=0
application-test.properties updated: spring.flyway.enabled=false (tests use H2 create-drop)
App starts without error against a fresh database
App starts without error against the existing dev database

userStories.title: Write V1 baseline migration (full schema)
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a SQL file that defines the complete current schema so any environment can be built from scratch using migrations alone.
acceptanceCriteria: File created at src/main/resources/db/migration/V1__baseline_schema.sql
File creates all tables: about, about_technologies, about_links, resume, resume_links, experience, post_entity
All primary keys, foreign keys, and column types match the current Hibernate-generated schema
resume.about is declared as TEXT (the intended final state)
Running the migration against a fresh DB produces a schema that Hibernate validates without error
userStories.notes: PostEntity has no @Table annotation so Hibernate maps it to post_entity

userStories.title: Write V2 migration for resume.about column type change
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a migration that alters the existing resume.about column from VARCHAR(255) to TEXT so pre-existing databases get the fix applied automatically.
acceptanceCriteria: File created at src/main/resources/db/migration/V2__alter_resume_about_to_text.sql
File contains: ALTER TABLE resume ALTER COLUMN about TYPE TEXT;
On a database where about is already TEXT, the migration is a no-op
App starts and Hibernate validates successfully after V2 runs

userStories.title: Validate full migration chain
userStories.description: As a developer, I want confidence that the migration chain works end-to-end so we don't discover broken migrations in production.
acceptanceCriteria: Fresh DB: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d, then mvn spring-boot:run — Flyway runs V1 + V2, Hibernate validates, app starts
Pre-existing DB: mvn spring-boot:run against current dev DB — Flyway baselines at V0, then runs V2, Hibernate validates, app starts
flyway_schema_history table exists in the database after startup
No Hibernate SchemaManagementException or Flyway FlywayException in logs
userStories.notes: Implementation verified correct. Manual runtime verification required with Docker (unavailable in sandbox).
